stage_timings.basis: No isolated durable E0 interval; launch timestamp is preserved by the beacon.
Beacon CREATE succeeded but connector result does not provide a durable stage start/end pair.
Boundary receipt proves two same-path branch-head movements but does not isolate E2 elapsed time.
Audit/exam close timestamp is durable; isolated E9 start is unavailable.

friction_events.description: The authority CREATE returned branch-head movement twice on the same claim path, including the one permitted stabilization retry.

Preclaim routing did not apply the POOL beacon-SHA hash after removing the definitively unsupported representative-JS-browser candidate; no authority was created before the terminal transport boundary.
Direct public Exit Audit URL fetch returned a cache miss, so the exact gh-pages file was read instead.

decision_trace.decision: Create a de-novo v3.30 worker identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Fresh-launch policy requires an atomic fresh beacon before any claim.
decision_trace.outcome: Beacon persisted successfully and worker identity was frozen.

decision_trace.decision: Attempt one atomic authority CREATE and then one same-path stabilization retry after branch-head movement.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The first CREATE returned HTTP 409 proving branch-head movement, not path existence or denial.
decision_trace.action: Retried the exact same claim path and payload once without pre-reading it.
decision_trace.outcome: The retry returned another branch-head movement; classified CLAIM_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE and stopped further claims.

decision_trace.decision: Do not conceal the preclaim routing deviation in the exit evidence.
decision_trace.observable_basis: For POOL mode the loaded contract requires capability filtering followed by beacon-commit hash sharding; the attempted candidate did not match that computation.
decision_trace.action: Recorded the deviation in exit_audit_v1 without attempting another candidate after the transport boundary.
decision_trace.outcome: No false ownership or productive slot was claimed; residual is explicit for later repair/evolution analysis.

top_time_sinks.note: Two consecutive branch-head movement responses prevented authority creation.
POOL hash routing was not applied correctly before the failed claim attempts.

unfinished_debt.item: No productive unit was executed; portfolio-human-time-ledger-consumer-wiring-v1 was not owned by this worker.
POOL sharding implementation at the worker surface needs deterministic enforcement so capability filtering and beacon-SHA indexing cannot be skipped.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Make POOL candidate selection executable from one retained frontier helper that filters definitive capability mismatches and returns the beacon-SHA-selected candidate plus next cyclic candidates.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce preclaim routing deviations without adding repository reads or a parallel allocator.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Use a create-if-absent transport primitive whose CAS is path-scoped rather than invalidated by unrelated branch-head movement, while preserving GitHub path atomicity.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce false claim transport instability under high concurrent worker write volume.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 PROD-01 worker created its own beacon but obtained no authority. Its claim transport hit two consecutive branch-head movements and closed at a transport boundary with zero productive units. The audit also records a preclaim POOL-sharding deviation; no ownership or completed work is overstated.
